building: 亞東科技大學有庠科技大樓
geometry_revision: v12 original STL bytes retained in later material/camera-only revisions
scope: Independent source, historical scope, plan topology and exterior appearance review of these exact artifacts. Not mesh/manufacturing QA, structural assessment, full scene-state equivalence, or physical-print certification.

original_pngs.name: front
original_pngs.observation: Street/corner overview: giant C frame retains its high inset opaque green pane, separate right-hand floor ends/open strips and low horizontal glazing. Ten principal rounded glass intervals, upper single window and A outer small-window rhythm remain distinct. No adjacent buildings are included.

original_pngs.name: rear
original_pngs.observation: Campus overview: long A extension, E multilevel crosslink, nonparallel B wing, D seven corner-window bands, tall lower glazing, open entry and broader projecting upper glass box remain legible. Box grooves and opaque colors are original simplified model details.

original_pngs.name: east
original_pngs.observation: Local +X elevation, not a surveyed compass east: tall recessed pane within C is visible on the existing end/support surfaces; slab ends and open strips remain separate. Low glazing and ground portal are not filled by the material change. C ten glass intervals retained.

original_pngs.name: west
original_pngs.observation: Local -X elevation: paper-left A short end is conservatively plain, not a mirrored copy of the long facade. E stacked open galleries and the D overhanging box remain distinct. Partial corner-window recesses are deliberately generalized; a blank model wall is not a claim of no actual windows.

original_pngs.name: south
original_pngs.observation: Local -Y elevation/campus side: D has seven ordinary corner bands below the higher projecting glass box, a taller low glass panel, genuine ground entry, sparse adjacent core openings and independent B broad-window rhythm. The A glass stair and inward gallery are separate landmarks.

original_pngs.name: north
original_pngs.observation: Local +Y long outer facade: fine paired-window approximation differs from inward galleries; narrow vertical glass strip and unequal end treatment retained. C ten round glass intervals plus separate upper single window visible. Counts/spacing of small ordinary windows are generalized, not a measured elevation.

original_pngs.name: top
original_pngs.observation: Top view preserves long A extension, nonparallel B, D projection and separate large trapezoidal courtyard/smaller end void, with E/F/C connections. Print-scale roundings and rooted terminal supports do not merge the voids. Simple visible roof cores exclude invented equipment and are not a complete roof survey.

original_pngs.name: courtyard-gallery
original_pngs.observation: Deliberate high downward perspective into the large court: repeated side galleries, recessed opaque windows and F crossing are visible through a deep open shaft. Darker ground and render grain remain visible; no geometry is concealed by a cropped facade or filled court. 2021 photo supports this topology, not the precise early rail/fitout details.

original_pngs.name: courtyard-arcade
original_pngs.observation: Repositioned high downward perspective into the smaller end void shows both side slab stacks, depth and the bright actual street-end aperture beside the tall opaque green pane. The earlier near-wall view was rejected. This image supports a distinct small shaft, without asserting measured dimensions or a fully documented early small-courtyard finish.

source_basis.use: School building identity and 13 above-ground / 3 basement levels. Separate identity of adjacent Chengqin and Yuanzhi buildings.
June 2007 school-authored opening report, opening 2007-05-12; campus photograph with EXIF Original 2007-04-26. School figure 51,336.4 square metres is gross floor area, not scale control.
School-hosted 3872×2592 campus photograph, EXIF Original 2008-05-16; projecting glazed box, seven lower corner-window bands, tall low glazing, open ground entrance and separate Chengqin building.

Contractor-attributed two complementary completed-building photographs, published 2010-04-12, capture dates unknown; street giant frame, ten rounded glass intervals, high inset glass plane, low horizontal glazed panel and campus landmarks. Self-attributed contractor page; identity cross-checked against school images.
Later school 9F allocation plan: long wing, nonparallel shorter wing, crosslinks and distinct voids. Not a dimensioned 2007 as-built drawing.
School 10F allocation plan dated 2025-09-18: corroborating relative topology only, not early interior layout.
Later school 11F allocation plan: corroborating topology and differing campus-end upper outline, not measured facades.
School 12F allocation image: relative plan tracing, long extension, nonparallel wing, two distinct courtyard voids and crosslinks. Exact image date and architectural dimensions unavailable.
School oblique campus diagram made in 2014: building separation and topology only, not a measured roof survey.
2021 school announcement and attributed courtyard photograph: deep courtyard and multilevel crossing/gallery existence only, not proof of unchanged 2007 fitout.
2022-07-13 meeting minutes page 2: planned facade and passage alterations establish version risk; these are plans, not completion evidence.
Early school resource record corroborates 51,336 square metres gross floor area; not used to derive footprint or height.

accepted_evidence_limits: Early representative exterior, based on 2007/2008 campus-side photographs. The street side uses a contractor photograph published in 2010 with unknown capture date; not every facade is verified for 2007/2008.
EXIF dates are camera metadata and can be edited; used alongside source publication and mutually matching building forms, not as survey certificates.

The 9F/11F files were produced in 2023, the 10F plan was edited in 2025, and the 12F image lacks firm early dating. They constrain consistent topology, not original room allocation, full elevations or 2007 dimensions.

All model dimensions are output-millimetre relative estimates. No actual building height, length, width, storey-height chain or exact 1:N scale was established. Floor-area figures 51,336.4 and 57,630 square metres have different unresolved scopes and were not used to derive scale.
X means plan-paper right, Y plan-paper up and Z vertical. East/west/north/south view filenames describe local model axes only, not verified geographic bearings.

Two nonparallel wings, an extending long wing, two distinct voids, campus and intermediate crosslinks, street giant frame and projecting campus glass box remain recognizable. Later upper-floor plans were not simply extruded as the entire ground-to-roof shell.

Campus D end preserves seven ordinary corner glass bands including the upper shadowed band, tall lower glazing and open ground entrance; street C corner preserves ten principal green intervals, white upper/lower zones and the observed upper single window. These are visible facade intervals, not asserted absolute floor labels.

Window spacing, count of small openings, groove depth, framing thickness, gallery guards, exact core offsets, roof heights and unknown podium details are generalized. Fine rails are thickened bands, glass is opaque original-color geometry, and no real glass transparency is asserted.

The tall glazing inside the street frame is assigned to existing physically recessed end/support surfaces. No new plane fills the signature high aperture; right-hand floor ends and open strips remain separate.

Paper-left short end and unobserved rear returns are conservatively simplified without mirrored window grids. Blank model surfaces do not assert that the actual building has no openings. Roof equipment, interiors, underground floors, adjacent Chengqin/Yuanzhi, hospital, old street buildings and landscaping are omitted.

The 2021 courtyard photograph is only structural/topological corroboration. The 2022 facade/passage improvement plans do not verify completion or any 2026 condition, and later finishes or closed entrances are not merged into this version.

Printing simplifications include rounded column/return corners, terminal gallery supports rooted into the wings, narrowed ground-portal edge and a common-axis street frame. These are documented model-scale construction choices, not measured building fittings.
No source photograph, PDF page, map, comparison crop or downloaded web content is included in the public review or used as a model texture. All public renders are original model renders.

Source/appearance GO is not manufacturability, structural or physical-print certification. Supports are required by the modeling assumptions and no physical print was performed; geometry and printing QA must pass separately.
